def test_encode_cyclic():
    # Single full group of 3: first char moves to end
    assert encode_cyclic("abc") == "bca"

    # Multiple full groups: each group cycled independently
    assert encode_cyclic("abcdef") == "bcaefd"
    assert encode_cyclic("abcdefghi") == "bcaefdhig"

    # Trailing group with fewer than 3 chars remains unchanged
    assert encode_cyclic("abcd") == "bcad"
    assert encode_cyclic("abcde") == "bcaed"

    # Groups of length 1 or 2 are unchanged
    assert encode_cyclic("") == ""
    assert encode_cyclic("a") == "a"
    assert encode_cyclic("ab") == "ab"

    # Verify decode_cyclic inverts encode_cyclic
    for s in ["", "a", "ab", "abc", "abcd", "hello", "world!", "abcdefg"]:
        assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic(s)) == s

    # Length is preserved
    for s in ["", "x", "xy", "xyz", "xyzw", "xyzwv"]:
        assert len(encode_cyclic(s)) == len(s)

    # Characters are preserved (permutation only)
    assert sorted(encode_cyclic("abcdef")) == sorted("abcdef")

def test_decode_cyclic():
    # Decoding an encoded string should return the original string
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("abc")) == "abc"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("")) == ""
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("a")) == "a"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("ab")) == "ab"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("abcd")) == "abcd"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("abcde")) == "abcde"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("abcdef")) == "abcdef"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("abcdefghi")) == "abcdefghi"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("hello world")) == "hello world"
    assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog")) == "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"

    # Decoding a known encoded value
    assert decode_cyclic("bca") == "abc"
    assert decode_cyclic("bcadef") == "abcdef"

    # Decoding twice-encoded string equals original
    for s in ["", "x", "xy", "xyz", "xyzw", "xyzwv", "aaa", "ababab", "!@#$%^&*()"]:
        assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic(encode_cyclic(s))) == s

    # decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic(s)) == s for random-ish strings of many lengths
    import string
    for n in range(0, 30):
        s = "".join(string.ascii_letters[i % len(string.ascii_letters)] for i in range(n))
        assert decode_cyclic(encode_cyclic(s)) == s
